subject: Split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory — proposal and ops appendix
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam Torres <liam.torres@arden-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory

Liam,

Thanks for taking the call last week. Per our discussion I attached a revised proposal that breaks the migration assistance into two parts: (1) an upfront accelerator credit to help cover initial cloud egress and engineering hours, and (2) a per-month bundle credit that phases down over 6 months. The goal is to reduce your near-term cash out while keeping unit economics aligned long-term.

Highlights in the attached arden-proposal-v2.pdf:
- Upfront accelerator: $45k credit against onboarding invoices (applied within first 30 days)
- Bundle inventory: SKU-level credits for inference (dedicated vs hosted) and a separate ops migration bucket
- Technical appendix: runtime compatibility notes and observable SLO adjustments

Quick ask: could you confirm (a) which environments you want dedicated vs hosted for the pilot, and (b) whether you need the credit split to be applied to a vendor-of-record or simply as invoice-level credits?

I copied Marissa and Grace for ops/implementation and legal handoffs.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
[Attachment: arden-proposal-v2.pdf]

From: Liam Torres <liam.torres@arden-sys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arden-sys.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory

Ben —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. High-level responses:
1) Pilot environments: we want the pilot to run mainly on dedicated GPUs for latency-sensitive endpoints (staging + prod), and use hosted for internal-only non-customer workloads.
2) Credit application: procurement will prefer vendor-of-record credits if possible (easier accounting), but finance can accept invoice credits if legal says vendor credits are infeasible.

A couple of follow-ups we need before I can take this to Finance:
- Can you send a SKU inventory mapping so we can see how many GPU-hours each bundle line maps to? (especially for the dedicated pool).
- Ops question: if we split the upfront $45k across two legal entities (Arden US and Arden EU) is that supported? We have a subsidiary billing constraint.

If you can get Marissa to confirm the technical compatibility notes and Grace to outline the billing flows, I can loop in procurement next Tue.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Torres
Head of ML Infrastructure | Arden Systems
liam.torres@arden-sys.com
[Quoted message omitted]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam Torres <liam.torres@arden-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory

Liam —

Thanks, quick answers inline and an ask for Marissa/Grace to confirm: 
- SKU inventory: attached bundle-inventory.xlsx maps each credit line to estimated GPU-hours and hosted token budgets. Numbers are conservative; we can tune after the pilot.
- Split across entities: we can allocate the upfront accelerator credit across two billing entities, but that requires a short amendment in the order form (legal) and a separate invoice mapping. It is doable; I flagged this for Grace.

Marissa: can you verify the compatibility bullets in the technical appendix? Specifically: 1) dedicated pool sizing for 2xP4s vs 1xA100-equivalent, and 2) whether the KV-cache warmup can be prioritized so the pilot hits the SLA in week one.

Grace: can you confirm we can do vendor-of-record crediting across Arden US/EU and outline the steps for the amendment and invoice split? If vendor-of-record isn't possible, please propose the quickest invoice-credit fallback.

Liam — I'll target procurement next Tue once Marissa/Grace confirm.

Cheers,
Ben
[Attachments: bundle-inventory.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Liam Torres <liam.torres@arden-sys.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory

Ben/Liam —

Reviewed the technical appendix and the bundle inventory. Notes and constraints:
- Dedicated sizing: the recommended 2xP4 pool will meet the pilot throughput for the latency targets, but headroom for burst traffic will require either (a) burst capacity enabled for 2 weeks post-launch or (b) one A100-equivalent node added to the pool. Option (a) is lower cost but requires us to provision burst capacity in the Dedicated config.
- KV-cache warmup: we can prioritize prefix warmups at the routing layer; however, it will add ~15% additional token consumption during the first 48 hours. We recommend leaving a burn window in the upfront credit for that.
- SKU mapping: the GPU-hour to credit conversion in bundle-inventory.xlsx looks correct assuming 20% caching savings. If Arden expects less caching, update the estimator (column G) before signoff.

Operational asks:
1) If we split the $45k across US/EU, ops needs entity tax IDs and the legal amendment signed prior to credit issuance.
2) Timeline: if procurement signs the order form by next Wed (8/25), we can schedule a pilot start for 9/7 with a 2-week warmup window.

I'll work with Grace on the billing language. Happy to jump on a 30m call with procurement next Tue to walk the SKU sheet.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment referenced: bundle-inventory.xlsx]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Torres <liam.torres@arden-sys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: split-credit accelerator + bundle inventory

Liam —

Confirmed: we can structure the upfront accelerator as vendor-of-record credits split between Arden US and Arden EU. Required next steps:
- Provide Arden US/EU legal entity names, addresses, and tax IDs (send to finance@redwood.com).
- Sign the short amendment (I will attach a redlined version once legal gets names).
- Once amendment countersigned, finance will issue two credit memos tied to the original PO numbers.

Fallback (invoice credit): if timelines are tight, we can issue invoice-level credits within 7 business days of the signed order, but vendor-crediting is cleaner for your accounting.

I'll prep the amendment template and loop in Legal. Ben — please send me Arden entity details when you have them. Liam — feel free to forward procurement’s preferred format for PO numbers.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
